resources.string: If the control site is unreachable directly, use the selected proxy for direct routes. Restore direct access when it recovers. LAN stays direct. Existing connections are reconnected.
Use an HTTPS site outside the whitelist. A HEAD response of 2xx/3xx is considered reachable; timeout is 3 seconds. Applies to generated configurations.
Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment.
The check interval must be from 5 to 3600 seconds.
local or localhost uses Android DNS on the underlying network. To use a DNS server running on this device, specify udp://127.0.0.1:53 explicitly.
